state.faq_question: What is the refund window for annual plans?
state.verified_answer: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase; after 30 days refunds are prorated.

Annual plans are non-refundable once activated; monthly plans can be cancelled anytime.
Annual plans offer a 15% discount over paying monthly and include priority support.
